note: A1+ Unit 1 Lesson 1.8 rebuilt on 2026-11-13 under the A1+ lesson standards approved 2026-10-27 and the user's 2026-11-09 rule that every A1+ lesson follows up the A1 lesson with the same number. A1 1.8 What They Are Not Doing pairs what people are doing with what they are not doing right now (The father is talking. He is not cooking.). A1+ 1.8 moves that to habits with don't and doesn't: A1's I do not becomes I don't, and he/she takes doesn't with the base verb (Diego doesn't cook dinner.). Facts, each in the evening: Ana cooks dinner and doesn't eat dinner at a restaurant (at her stove), Diego doesn't cook dinner (he eats at a restaurant), Luis watches TV in the evening (on his sofa) and Sofia doesn't watch TV in the evening (she reads, her TV off). Luis's habit stays in the I-form so the -es spelling (watches) is not a second new form. Ana and Sofia share one voice, as do Luis and Diego, so each Learn pair crosses voices. A negative cannot be photographed: every photo shows what the person does, and a don't/doesn't sentence only meets a photo that contradicts it or is told apart by a name or by he/she. Listen sets the habit form against A1 1.8's is not ...-ing. No Does...? or short answers (1.9) and no every day.

lesson.title: 1.8 What they don't do
lesson.unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people’s habits.
lesson.goal: Say what you and other people don't do as a habit, with don't and doesn't (I don't cook dinner. / Diego doesn't cook dinner.), next to what they do (Ana cooks dinner.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 1.8 What They Are Not Doing: A1 says what people are not doing right now (He is not cooking.); A1+ 1.8 says what they don't do as a habit. The one new grammar relationship is don't/doesn't + the base verb: A1's I do not becomes I don't, and he/she takes doesn't, which takes the -s off the verb (Diego doesn't cook dinner.). Listen sets it against A1's is not ...-ing (Diego is not cooking dinner.).
lesson.prerequisite: A1 1.7-1.8 cooking and not; A1 4.8 and 5.5 I do not; A1 5.7 dinner; A1 2.1 restaurant; A1 4.10 in the evening; A1 7.6 watch TV; A1+ 1.2 he/she -s (cooks, eats).
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say don't and doesn't clearly, with the final t light but present, and keep the verb without -s after doesn't (doesn't cook). Do not require native-like speed.
